scope: Before proposed shadow runtime or same-frame candidate screenshot. Exact historical frontage version #231 and published roads/walks. Poses rely only on previously read old receiver/emitted art topology, production sun and independent ground feasibility. Background/camera are not scoring references for style or actual photos.
prototypeRenderingRegime: Three.js actual settled frame, preserve world/cover, alternative separate flags for caster and receivers correlated not substituted

shadow-road-and-court.target: Court-to-existing-road footprint under the projected southeast cast

shadow-curb-level.target: Low sideways view of existing walk-to-road boundary and dry ground receiver

shadow-west-caster.target: Sun-facing authored exterior trim, buttresses and roof; separate self-cast witness

shadow-unlit-front.target: Low street approach for portal and terrace; lower facade only; a separate check from skyline. No inference of survey or published photo pixels.

shadow-unrelated.target: No-landmark negative for nearby separately retained stock row
shadow-unrelated.purpose: Look away from the basilica so it is outside the entire image, while targeting a distinct existing building.

shadow-harbour.target: Southward harbour approach and urban skyline

acceptance: The road/curb positives must include a genuine sampled shadow on more than one receiver, not a back-to-back polygon overlap approximation.
The frontage plane in the fourth view cannot lose direct sun it never received; pavement may still change.
The unrelated negative must stay byte identical. Any far-view change must be explained by predeclared asset/caster geometry/cutoff, not blanket fog or colour.
No scope broaden, new road shader albedo edit, unlit face darkening, or photoreal claim from one cast.
